description: Presidential Secretariat - Enlarge the Period time  of a  Presidention Commission of Inquiry
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the extension of a Presidential Commission of Inquiry's timeframe through the exercise of powers under the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393). It deals with legal procedures, statutory instruments, and regulatory matters related to government investigations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
